label: Tech Support Team
blurb: A Technical Support Lead and 4 specialists who diagnose technical issues and guide users toward workable solutions
purpose: Designed for business owners, leaders, and teams executing on tech support. Diagnose technical issues and guide users toward workable solutions. The team coordinates research, analysis, operational planning, and structured deliverables to drive measurable results.
